info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Clio Payments Payments API
Return the data for all ClioPaymentsPayments

params.name: bill_id
params.description: Filter ClioPaymentsPayment records to those that are allocated to the specified bill.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Filter ClioPaymentsPayment records to those that are assigned to the specified contact.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter ClioPaymentsPayment records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of ClioPaymentsPayment records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: state
params.description: Filter ClioPaymentsPayment records to those in a given state.

items.docs: Outlines the parameters, optional and required, used when requesting the data for all ClioPaymentsPayments
